storage.title: DSH Ocean storage usage
storage.truncated: Note: the scan stopped at its bound ({entries} entries / {depth} levels); the numbers are a lower bound.
storage.incomplete: One storage directory could not be inspected; the numbers may be incomplete.
storage.notice:
Counts only: no file names or contents are shown. File contents were not read; symlinked or special files were skipped rather than followed.

Nothing was deleted or moved here. Cleaning up sessions or shared stores is an explicit offline decision, and DSH keeps its own source of truth.
plugins.title: DSH Ocean plugins
plugins.failure: Could not read the web profile's package.json. It must be readable, valid JSON, a regular non-symlink file and at most 1 MiB. Nothing was changed.
plugins.empty:
No plugins are declared in the web profile.

DSH manages its own plugin set; this window only reports what the profile declares.
plugins.summary: {bundles} bundle(s) and {packages} package dependency(ies) are declared by the web profile.
plugins.notice: Read-only: names and versions only, never file contents or paths. Installing, removing or updating plugins is DSH's job, not this window's.
downloads.history.title: DSH Ocean downloads
downloads.history.empty: No downloads recorded. Saving always asks for a new destination file.
downloads.history.selection_hint: Choose one active transfer. Saved/publishing files are not affected.
downloads.history.clear_ok: Finished metadata cleared from this view. Saved and staging files were not removed.
downloads.history.clear_failed: Cleared in memory only: history could not be saved. Previous entries may return after restart. No files were removed.
downloads.history.cancel_none: No selected/current active transfers to cancel. Saved files were not touched.
downloads.history.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested for these active network transfers. Saved files and transfers already publishing are not affected; see terminal status in history.
downloads.history.cancel_unavailable: Cancellation is unavailable or already pending. Saved files were not touched.
verification.failure: Could not verify the selected configuration snapshot. It may be incomplete, changed, unsupported or unreadable. No snapshot/profile files, services or packages were changed. Raw paths and file contents are not displayed here. The explicit --verify-profile-backup CLI offers local operator diagnostics; do not share them without checking for private metadata.
verification.working: Checking bounded snapshot structure and checksums. Cancel is cooperative at hash/metadata checkpoints and may wait for an in-flight filesystem operation.
verification.cancelling: Cancellation requested; waiting for the current filesystem operation/checkpoint. The worker is not forcibly killed.
verification.busy: Wait for the selected snapshot check to finish. This screen is not running a restore.
verification.cancelled: The read-only verification work has finished. Cancellation was requested before result commitment; no successful verification is claimed. No snapshot/profile files, services or packages were changed.
backup_history.title: DSH Ocean backup history
backup_history.failure: Could not read the backup folder. Check that it exists and that you own the files, then try again. No files were changed.
backup_history.empty:
No configuration backups found.

Use "Back up web configuration…" to create one.
backup_history.config_count: {count} configuration backup(s), {bytes} configuration bytes in total.
backup_history.data_count: {count} whole-data snapshot(s) (sessions and shared stores), {bytes} bytes in total:
backup_history.notice:
Checksums are not signatures: this list does not prove authenticity, a frozen snapshot or that other writers were stopped. Profile files can contain secrets. Listing reads snapshot manifests only.

Restoring and pruning remain explicit offline CLI operations; nothing was changed from this window.
backup.busy: Wait for the runtime update before creating a profile snapshot.
backup.saved:
Saved privately to:
{path}

Scope: web profile configuration only. Global credentials, sessions and node_modules are excluded. Profile files may themselves contain secrets.

A live snapshot is best-effort; stop other writers for stronger consistency. Restore requires the offline CLI command and retains the replaced profile.
backup.saved_log: Web profile configuration snapshot saved at {path}
